=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (2026-06-08) ===
• trinodb/trino #7885 (WebFetch): `COUNT(DISTINCT col) OVER (...) is not supported in Trino` — analysis error message: 'DISTINCT in window function parameters not yet supported: count(DISTINCT orderstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY custkey)'. Issue remains OPEN as a feature request. Confirms COUNT(DISTINCT) OVER fails at analysis stage before execution in Trino 467.
• Cumulative-distinct == running-SUM-of-first-appearances identity: mathematically correct. Each entity contributes +1 EXACTLY ONCE in its first-appearance period. SUM-of-first-appearance-counts through period N ≡ cardinality of {entities first-appearing on or before period N} ≡ cumulative-distinct entities through period N. Confirmed across grains (day/week/month) and first-appearance criteria (first order/paid/event/signup).
• MIN(date) GROUP BY entity_id (first-appearance primitive): standard Trino aggregate idiom — `min()` returns the minimum value of all input values for any comparable type (DATE, TIMESTAMP, etc).
• SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY col ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW): documented running-sum window form, already canonical at Pattern A r07:1700+ and Pattern A2 r07:1868+.
